lighthouse.desc: Performance optimization based on two rounds of Lighthouse analysis. Removed 4 unused fonts (12 files), implemented interaction-based lazy loading for reCAPTCHA, applied font-display:swap to achieve mobile Performance 60→98, and reduced page size by 70%.

bunny.name: Mongi
bunny.subtitle: A little bunny who lives in this village
bunny.story1: Meet Mongi (夢), a dream-like little bunny who lives in this village. Her name carries both the dreams you have at night and the dreams you hold during the day.
bunny.story2: She's proud of her big, round eyes that never miss a detail, and her perky ears always tuned to people's voices. Mongi drifts leisurely through this space, sometimes swaying gently to the music before you even notice.
bunny.story3: Curious by nature, she reacts quickly to new things — but she's a bit timid, so she'll jump if you approach too suddenly. She loves challenges, yet never loses her sense of caution. Shall we look around with Mongi? She'll warmly welcome everyone who visits here.
